newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa thinly traded, surrender gains.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa thinly traded, surrender gains.

text.p: Cocoa futures surrendered early gains to end Wednesday midsession unchanged as a run-up on the back of light volume proved shortlived.
Sterling's renewed advance to above three marks was also not supportive. But by late morning it backtracked again, testing below the three mark level.
Cocoa was called seven to eight stg higher on the back of New York's advance on Tuesday.
It made its due, with September rising to a high of 1,052 stg a tonne before ending the morning business unchanged at 1,045, the day's low.
New York closed $18 higher at $1,595 basis September but failed to clear the $1,600 mark on arbitrage selling against London.

Technically, traders said London's cocoa was still on the upside bias, with the market ultimately testing the 1,087-1,108 chart gap seen as major resistance. --Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
